headline: Cherki Sees test4 Home By Two
deck: test4 edged test3 26-24, Cherki's seven the top score in a tie where Pickford matched him.
body:
Cherki settled it. His seven led test4, and with Justin adding six behind him the margin held at two. E.Le Fée weighed in with five; the tail of Gray, Mbeumo and N.Williams gave only two apiece, but the top of the line-up did enough.

test3 will feel this one. Pickford matched Cherki with seven from goal, and Ndiaye's five kept the chase alive, but the forwards let him down. Emersonn, Gonzalo and Gibbs-White managed two each, and Grimes three, and none of it closed the gap.

Two points, three men on two. test3 had the goalkeeper and the midfield return he wanted and still came up short where he needed his strikers most.
